data.name: Yehoron
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Yehoron is derived from the Hebrew words yah (God) and horon (gracious). The name signifies that God is gracious and merciful. In the Bible, this name is not explicitly mentioned, but it is present in the list of the descendants of Aaron and Eleazar (Exodus 6:21).
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of reverence and devotion to God's graciousness.

in_latin.name: Jehoron
